card.name: Spots just before dose amounts
card.fires_on: Spaces and small words right before a number in dosing text, such as 'increments of' or 'dose is', plus a few words in treatment or dosing phrases.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A bare space token right before a dose figure such as 10 mg or 37.5 mg.

modes.label: Dosing and treatment terms
modes.description: Words inside dosing or treatment phrases, such as dosing, dose increases or self-help.

modes.label: Written responses
modes.description: The word responses after 'written' in a news quote.
modes.example: Grade said in written<< responses>> to questions posed by Civil Engineering online.

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to sessions and presenting, and the suppressed ones relate to writing a letter or document, so the effect is unclear.
